observability.md: Choose signals that explain user harm, turn them into reliability contracts, and connect alerts to a clear response. Follow the path from telemetry selection to incident investigation.
observability/telemetry-taxonomy.md: A product event, a crash breadcrumb and a reliability metric answer different questions. Choose the signal, owner and data policy before adding an SDK call.
observability/logging.md: A useful log preserves the context needed to explain a failure. Learn how to control message construction, sensitive fields and release routing.
observability/structured-logging.md: Stable fields make diagnostic records queryable across modules. Keep schemas consistent and propagate only the context that belongs to the current operation.
observability/metrics.md: A fleet result starts with observations on individual devices. Learn which aggregates can be merged, how dimensions multiply, and what an export can lose.
observability/tracing.md: A slow checkout crosses several pieces of work. Use spans, context and sampling to account for the execution path without pretending every boundary is instrumented.
observability/distributed-tracing.md: A trace header crosses a trust boundary as well as a network boundary. Follow client context through ingress validation, backend work and trace export.
observability/slis.md: Healthy servers do not guarantee a working app. Define eligible operations and correct outcomes so the measurement represents what users can actually do.
observability/slos.md: A reliability target needs a population, units and a window. Separate product promises from vendor thresholds and use explicit policies to guide release decisions.
observability/error-budgets.md: A budget makes release risk discussable. Calculate it over one population, handle missing evidence, and agree on consequences before reliability declines.
observability/alerting.md: A page should lead to a useful action. Combine windows, traffic and current user impact, then route the problem to an owner with a mitigation.
observability/dashboards.md: Start with user impact and drill into the affected cohort. Build an overview that leads an investigator to the evidence needed for the next decision.
